CabanesYourtesPage.title: Cabanes et Yourtes de la Vallée de l'Ance
CabanesYourtesPage.subtitle: Website for unusual accommodations in the heart of nature
CabanesYourtesPage.heroDescription: A showcase website designed to promote eco-friendly accommodations nestled in the Auvergne countryside.
aboutParagraphs: A personal project with professional aims, consisting of designing and developing the showcase website for Cabanes et Yourtes de la Vallée de l'Ance tourist accommodations. The site presents the lodgings, local activities, and availability, highlighting the natural and artisanal identity of the place.

I carry out the entire process: needs analysis, zoning, wireframe, mockup in Figma, front-end integration (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), and deployment. Development is done in continuous interaction with the owners to adjust content and design based on their feedback. The site is fully responsive and relies on a natural palette of green and brown tones. Site images were taken on location with RC Creation.
nrItems: Images optimized in AVIF format to reduce page weight
Subdued color palette limiting energy consumption on OLED screens
Lightweight code without heavy frameworks (HTML, CSS, vanilla JS)
No third-party cookies or unnecessary trackers
features: Responsive design adapted to all devices
Subtle animations to enhance user experience

IUTDefensePage.title: IUT defense management
IUTDefensePage.subtitle: Web application for managing internship evaluations at the IUT Informatique
IUTDefensePage.heroDescription: A comprehensive web application to centralize the management of internship and apprenticeship defenses.
aboutParagraphs: Team project carried out during the second year of IUT Informatique. The objective was to design a web application centralizing the complete management of internship and apprenticeship defenses: jury assignment, entry and consultation of evaluation grids, grade tracking, account administration (professors, students), automation of certain internal tasks (emails, data uploads) as well as work on data security.

I developed the professor's home page (personalized view of upcoming and past defenses, dynamic sorting) and ensured the complete design integration (global CSS conforming to the IUT's graphic charter).
Collaborative project spanning over a month using agile methodology, with GitHub for version control and VS Code for development.
nrItems: Optimized SQL queries to limit unnecessary database access
Minimalist CSS without heavy CSS frameworks
Access rights management to limit unauthorized requests
features: CSV export and automatic email sending

UIDesignPosterPage.title: Album cover CV
UIDesignPosterPage.subtitle: LinkedIn campaign & personal branding - album concept
UIDesignPosterPage.heroImageAlt: LinkedIn post visual with album cover style
UIDesignPosterPage.heroDescription: A CV reimagined as an album cover to capture recruiters' attention on LinkedIn.
aboutParagraphs: As part of the "Personal and Professional Project" module, I designed a disruptive internship search campaign for April 2025. Rather than simply posting a PDF CV, I chose to treat my application as the release of a "debut single".

The concept builds on a strong analogy between music and code: rhythm, balance, and the absence of dissonance. The main visual is a "stylized album cover" where traditional CV information is graphically reinterpreted to capture recruiters' attention in a saturated LinkedIn feed.
features: Skills tracklist: original presentation of hard skills (web dev).
"Release" approach: announcing the internship as an exclusive release from an emerging artist.
Design in Affinity: graphic tools mastery demonstrated through practice.
Double impact: simultaneous showcase of technical skills (Affinity) and creative abilities (the idea itself).

ClimbImprovePage.title: ClimbImprove
ClimbImprovePage.subtitle: Revolutionizing climbing through AI and connected objects
ClimbImprovePage.heroDescription: A conceptual project combining artificial intelligence and connected objects to improve climbing practice.
aboutParagraphs: Completed in pairs as part of an English course during the second year of BUT Informatique. ClimbImprove is a conceptual project aiming to revolutionize climbing through the combination of artificial intelligence and connected objects.

To work within tight deadlines while exploring AI technologies, we used Figma Make to simulate the service architecture. My role was to imagine the overall concept and fully develop the showcase website, the centerpiece of our booth evaluation.

This site details a complete ecosystem: an application capable of biomechanical video analysis ("Movement Analysis") and personalized coaching ("Smart Guidance"), coupled with durable connected holds made of wood and polyester.
nrItems: Lightweight static showcase site without database
Use of Figma Make to prototype without developing a server
Connected holds concept using sustainable materials (wood and polyester)
features: Movement Analysis: real-time biomechanical video analysis
Pressure sensors integrated into connected holds
Route creation tools for route setters
